basis: Include this composite proposal observation on explicit data-center infrastructure tax/eligibility grounds: official HB2047/SB2584 abstract identifies qualified data centers, and officially linked SA0665 expressly defines data-center facilities, equipment and incentive qualification. Inclusion covers the documented proposed amendment component, not a finding that it was adopted or enacted. Section 3 connects the facility definition to industrial-machinery exemption and credit. This clears the prior missing facility-definition scope gap. Preserve failed category, original-versus-amendment distinction and unknown final adoption; no assertion that proposed thresholds newly tightened existing law or establish current eligibility.
